    Use cases
    
      
    Every template is tagged with the moments it fits. The matcher ranks templates by how many of the moment's use cases they share.
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
      
    Thresholds
    
      
    
        
    Blowout / Cat Watch
    NFL & CFB 14+ pts · NBA, WNBA & college basketball 15+ · MLB 5+ runs · NHL 3+ goals
    
        
    Gator Watch
    Florida beats a team: the loser is Chubbs (never on a Florida loss)
    
        
    Cat fight
    Two cat teams play each other
    
        
    Post windows (ET)
    Morning 8–10 AM · Late night 10 PM–12 AM · the next window that leaves an hour to make the meme · Weekend NFL/CFB: also a Meme of the Week candidate
    
        
    Rotation
    Templates used in the last 7 days drop in the ranking
    
      
    
    
    
    
    
      
    Team numbers for After Effects
    
      
    Builds a "Teams" tab per league in your data sheet (NFL, NBA, WNBA, MLB, NHL, college football, college basketball), numbered alphabetically: pro teams by nickname, colleges by school. Numbers never change once given; new teams are added at the end. Finalized memes use these numbers.
